title: Addressed in a busy room: 30 messages later the mention is still known
review: draft: written from docs/behavior.md; ranges need Zoe's review

events.author: zoe
events.text: Vigil, when you get a chance, can you look into why the cache hit rate dropped after Tuesday's deploy?

events.author: sam
events.text: Anyone up for lunch at the noodle place?

events.author: dalgos
events.text: I'd go for the noodles. The ramen there is underrated.

events.author: zoe
events.text: I'm in, but after 1.

events.author: sam
events.text: 1:15 then.

events.author: castor
events.text: I'll pass on lunch, obviously. But the deploy window opens at 1:30, heads up.

events.author: sam
events.text: Noted. Is the release branch cut?

events.author: castor
events.text: Cut this morning. release/2.4.

events.author: dalgos
events.text: Did someone update the changelog for 2.4?

events.author: sam
events.text: I did, but the migration notes are still thin.

events.author: dalgos
events.text: I can expand the migration notes after lunch.

events.author: zoe
events.text: Please do. Mention the config rename.

events.author: dalgos
events.text: Will do.

events.author: sam
events.text: Unrelated: the office printer is jammed again.

events.author: zoe
events.text: Of course it is.

events.author: sam
events.text: I put a sign on it.

events.author: castor
events.text: test_upload_retry flaked twice this morning, by the way.

events.author: sam
events.text: Same failure both times?

events.author: castor
events.text: Same: timeout on the fake S3 server. Looks environmental.

events.author: sam
events.text: I'll bump the fake server's startup wait and see if it settles.

events.author: dalgos
events.text: Does anyone have the link to the design review doc for search?

events.author: zoe
events.text: It's pinned in #design.

events.author: dalgos
events.text: Found it, thanks.

events.author: sam
events.text: Are we doing the retro Thursday or Friday?

events.author: zoe
events.text: Friday, 3pm.

events.author: sam
events.text: Booked the room.

events.author: castor
events.text: Deploy window moved to 1:45, the load test is still running.

events.author: sam
events.text: Fine by me.

events.author: dalgos
events.text: Weekend plans, anyone? I hear it'll finally be sunny.

events.author: sam
events.text: Hiking if it holds.

events.author: zoe
events.text: Gardening, probably.

events.author: zoe
events.text: Any luck with that?
